usages.explain: After emphasizing a clause with the particle に to express multiple meanings, now one adds the particle も with the meaning "not only with that, but also with something else."

examples.content: こんな物は毒にも薬にも成らぬ。
examples.transcription: こんなものはどくにもくすりにもならぬ。
examples.mean: This kind of thing is neither poison nor medicine.

examples.content: ミンさんにもよろしくお伝えください。
examples.transcription: みんさんにもよろしくおつたえください。
examples.mean: Please give my regards to Min as well.

examples.content: 大阪にも強い地震が起きた。
examples.transcription: おおさかにもつよいじしんがおきた。
examples.mean: A strong earthquake also occurred in Osaka.

title: にも => also, too, not ... either, as well, even
